tasks.title: Baseline de producto y entorno
tasks.acceptance: PRD y versiones fijadas; revisar alcance y preparar daemon/fixtures aislados; ningún proyecto real alterado

evidence.notes: Versions pinned; isolated daemon (own home/port) started and checked; fixtures created; no real project touched.
evidence.limitations: No provider inference; credential sharing with regular home not verified.

tasks.title: Contrato del compositor y routing inicial
tasks.acceptance: POC-01/02: control nativo, opt-in, metadata, proveedor correcto antes de inferencia y sesión normal intacta

evidence.notes: POC-01/02 on Paseo 0.17.4 (isolated daemon, web build in headless Chrome, OpenCode free inference only): addComposerItem/addNewWorkspaceItem host the opt-in control; host settings persist it; agent.create.before applies provider/model/mode before any session/inference, fails closed on throw or invalid provider, respects manual override, leaves non-opted-in sessions untouched. FAIL rows: 1.8 (workspace metadata does not reach initial agent), 1.10 (setProvider at cold mount rejected) - design implications recorded.
evidence.limitations: Electron window, compact/mobile/theme, plugin-down and hook-timeout (fail-open expected), multi-plugin ordering, restart persistence and type-checking NOT RUN; surfaces missing from plugin reference docs were found in the runtime.

tasks.title: Catálogo y cuotas
tasks.acceptance: POC-03: captura saneada de API pública real, freshness, reset, unknown y compatibilidad 0.17.4

evidence.notes: POC-03: providers.snapshot()/listUsage() and CLI usage ls verified on Paseo 0.17.4 in an isolated daemon with an empty profile and a synthetic usage source (0, 100, null, absent, resetsAt, no_quota preserved). Empty profile => unknown for every provider.
evidence.limitations: Real authenticated account quotas NOT RUN (credentials deliberately excluded; needs owner approval of scope); usage inspect of an existing report BLOCKED by a port collision with another POC; other Paseo versions NOT RUN.

tasks.title: Roles, herramientas y permisos
tasks.acceptance: POC-04/05/06: agente directo, caller identity, MCP on/off y matriz de restricciones reales

evidence.notes: POC-04 PASS (direct agent creation, no Agent Profiles, caller-chosen agentId). POC-05 PASS WITH CONDITIONS: per-session tool injection before first turn works, but caller identity on the Paseo-MCP route (callerAgentId URL param) is spoofable (05.3 FAIL); identity-safe route is a plugin-hosted MCP server with per-session bearer secret (verified on OpenCode/Codex, authenticated connect on Claude). POC-06 restriction matrix produced: Paseo tool policy is per provider only; per-session deny works for Claude (Bash/Task/Agent) and OpenCode (bash); agent.open.before parent-label veto blocks child creation; Codex shell not removable (behavioral anti-recursion).
evidence.limitations: Several matrix cells NOT RUN (Codex subagent switch, Claude mcp__paseo deny, OpenCode permission.task, non-default thinking, own-MCP secret exposure to same-user processes, daemon password mode). Claude/Codex per-session restriction claims are model-reported. Inference used: Claude 2, Codex 2, OpenCode free 8 trivial prompts.
